positions.name: SprintOutcomeCausalChain
positions.frame: What does this sprint's outcome show about the causal chain from integration choice to velocity to shipped delivery?
positions.why: The three assertions build a single directional narrative rather than three independent facts: the Zephyr integration (src-3) is named as the enabling cause, the 23-point velocity (src-2) is the measured effect, and the shipped widget (src-1) is the delivered outcome. All three share the same matter-of-fact, past-tense, realis register and the same self-enhancement/competence valuation (per the directional reads) — read together they perform one retrospective case for 'this sprint worked, and here is why,' rather than three unrelated status updates. No internal tension: all three point the same direction toward validated delivery.
